name: bufA
meaning: AnimJointPose[jointCount]: pose of the key being left ('from'); interpolation input A; swapped with B on every key step (ScnBody +0x44)

name: bufB
meaning: AnimJointPose[jointCount]: pose of the key being approached ('to'); always the destination of Anim_DecodeKey (ScnBody +0x48)

name: bufC
meaning: AnimJointPose[jointCount]: displayed pose written by Anim_InterpolatePose, read by Instance_DrawAnimParts and Anim_GetRootOffset; final key swapped in when a non-looping anim ends (ScnBody +0x4c)

name: pendingSoundId
meaning: key event id: set from key 0 unconditionally (can clear it), from later keys only when non-zero; consumed and zeroed by 0x50d540 (sound id, 0x158 = rumble) (ScnBody +0x54)

name: frameDuration
meaning: duration of current key (x1024 time units) (ScnBody +0x5e)

name: flags
meaning: AnimFlags: 1 playing, 2 looping, 4 ping-pong/alt wrap, 8 finished (ScnBody +0x62)
